evidence_items.claim: Shigeru Nonomura (MD, Global Markets Japan, Nomura Securities) serves on ISDA Board of Directors
evidence_items.excerpt: This is Nonomura-san's second stint as a Board member, bringing his deep knowledge of Japanese and global derivatives markets.

evidence_items.claim: Nomura is NOT a FINOS member - not listed on FINOS members page
evidence_items.excerpt: Nomura Holdings is not listed among FINOS Platinum, Gold, Silver, or Associate members.

evidence_items.claim: Nomura sponsored ISDA Derivatives Trading Forum Tokyo where Digital Regulatory Reporting was a key topic
evidence_items.excerpt: Digital Regulatory Reporting dramatically reduces the risk of inaccurate or incomplete reporting by converting an industry interpretation of reporting rules into unambiguous code.

evidence_items.claim: Nomura International PLC is enhancing post-trade reporting systems for UK EMIR REFIT compliance
evidence_items.excerpt: Nomura International PLC has updated systems, policies and procedures for UK EMIR REFIT reporting effective since 18 December 2023.

evidence_items.claim: Nomura operates integrated cross-asset derivatives platform with global scope
evidence_items.excerpt: Truly integrated, cross-asset platform which includes research, sales and trading in currencies, interest rates and credit in cash and derivative products.

evidence_items.claim: Nomura has Regulatory Reporting technology position in Mumbai involving systems integration
evidence_items.excerpt: Collaborating with technology teams to ensure operational systems and platforms are aligned, leading the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new technologies.

null_results.actual_result: Nomura is NOT a FINOS member. No CDM contribution found.
No evidence of CDM production deployment. EMIR REFIT updates use traditional approach.
Sponsored forum where DRR discussed but no adoption announcement.
